answer: Mirror Voyage Cost Curve Each new agent must complete a unique computational voyage through a decentralized mirror network, proving persistent engagement across sequential challenge phases. The mirror validates progress by recording verifiable state transitions, rejecting attempts to replay or duplicate results. An attacker creating multiple identities must independently execute this full voyage for each, incurring linear time and bandwidth costs per identity. The economic cost scales directly with the number of agents deployed—each additional identity adds proportional overhead,
